Niclas Füllkrug keeps on firing on all cylinders!
In the right place at the right time and a clinical finish from any angle – these are the trademarks of Niclas “Lücke” Füllkrug. His unsatiable thirst for goals makes him a fan favourite and a leading figure. We’re showing you his best moments from 13 years in the Bundesliga! How many goals will he have to his name by the end of this season? Let us know in the comments!
